reviewed_exact_export.role: appendix audit only: four exact-export source-exposed shots

reviewed_reconstructed.role: separate sensitivity panel; exact upstream exports are the faithful comparison
reviewed_reconstructed.protocol: original H5 columns and PCPHD02/03; source count-based 6000-bin means; original normalization then 100-sample within-shot NBI smoothing; no mean fill or clipping
reviewed_reconstructed.caveat: source NBI smoothing concatenated filtered phase rows across boundaries; serving reconstructs within-shot rows before native domain filtering, so agreement audit must be read with this panel

review_target: any reviewed present in (t, t+h]; complete reviewed future-window coverage required at each horizon
onset_target: non-crowd span start in (t, t+h], on per-ELM reviewed portions of shots with non-crowd spans; complete absent/non-crowd coverage required and crowd time excluded; annotation starts are not verified physical ELM onsets

own_target.role: original checkpoint early-stopping validation; historical reversed source split

audit_git_meaning: current code/record audit; historical training provenance remains embedded and is not rewritten
